nt_cs3507_truck.desc: prime mover and semi-trailer, side view, four wheels; 1108 x 350 at type A (P x N), traced from the sheet's sign face (the sheet also gives it on a 25-square grid)

notes: Department of Logistics and Infrastructure (DIPL) civil standard drawing, CAD sheet in colour; every dimension from the sheet unless stated; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet CS3507 'Limited compression braking information sign' (2017), table type A: A 1600 square, R 200; B 20 black border with C 40 = edge + border (white edge 20); D 110 margin to the yellow panel (retroreflective yellow, black border H 20, gap K 60, REDUCE NOISE M 120 'DM' = Series D, cap top 190); G 85 to the truck, N 350 tall x P 1108 wide (P dimensioned over the truck), centred; G 85 to PLEASE LIMIT / COMPRESSION / BRAKING E 140 'DM' (Series D), F 80 between lines, D 110 at the bottom: chain D K H M H K G N G E F E F E D = 1600. Panel corner radii and word gaps not stated (panel R measured about 50 outer; REDUCE NOISE gap measured 162 at type A; the lower lines' word gap taken as the letter height). Type A for residential/urban perimeters, type B for multilane roads. The sheet's CAD text is letter-spaced wider than AS 1744 (no width check). Overlay against the type A sheet for both.
